mira_ml: Quick heads-up — I just re-ran the Q3 traffic sims. We should expect a ~45% peak in token throughput for a 10-day window in mid-August (regional variance: NA +55%, EU +35%, APAC +25%). Need a plan for GPU hours + reservation mix.

anna_infra: Thanks — can you paste the input assumptions?

mira_ml: Sure, quick paste of the simplified calc we used: 
```
baseline_tokens_per_min = 220_000_000  # current global avg
peak_multiplier = 1.45
peak_tokens_per_hour = baseline_tokens_per_min * 60 * peak_multiplier
# conservative per-GPU throughput (serving workload): ~110B tokens / GPU / hour (H200 quantized path)
gpu_throughput_tokens_per_hour = 110_000_000_000
gpu_hours_needed = peak_tokens_per_hour / gpu_throughput_tokens_per_hour
print(gpu_hours_needed)  # ~270 GPU-hours on H200-equivalent at peak per hour (global)
```
Note: numbers rounded; mix of short requests reduces batching efficiency, so we add 18% headroom.

sam_ops: If that's per-hour peak, multiply by 24 and by days in window — that balloons. We need hourly distribution. Do we expect sustained or spikey?

mira_ml: Mostly spikey with diurnal pattern and 3 short surge days. 6 hours/day above 1.2x, 3 hours/day above 1.4x for the 10-day window.

anna_infra: Thinking in procurement terms: H200 lead time ~12-20 weeks (varies by region/partner), H100 ~8-12 weeks, L40S ~6-10 weeks. We can't frontload all H200s. Proposal: reserve 50% of anticipated peak H200-equivalents as confirmed Dedicated reservations, keep 30% as burst-eligible capacity (spot/partner burst), and 20% as on-demand L40S for non-latency-critical batch jobs. @tyler_sourcing any procurement constraints?

tyler_sourcing: Current supplier queue shows H200 availability limited in Q3 slots for NA region — there's a 2-4 week slot jitter. We can lock a partial park (50% requested) but need approval for budget + flexible shipping. Also exploring OEM partner for staggered shipments to mitigate single-lead-time risk.

jordan_finance: What are rough cost deltas? If we shift 20% of H200-hours to L40S, what's savings? Also need estimate for reserved vs on-demand cost.

mira_ml: Back-of-envelope: H200 reserved effective cost ~ $6.50 / GPU-hour (committed), on-demand ~ $9.5. L40S on-demand ~ $2.8 (but lower perf for low-latency). For mixed workload we trade latency for 40-60% unit cost savings on non-critical workloads.

anna_infra: Network/regional constraints: APAC egress and multi-region replication adds ~6-9% on infra time due to cross-region tails. If we route more to APAC L40S for embeddings, watch for higher tail variance and SLO noise.

sam_ops: Operational note: autoscale cooldowns and batch queue throttles need tuning to avoid overshooting cold-start GPUs. Recommend reducing scale-out step from 10 -> 4 GPUs and enabling early KV-prefix cache reuse to shave latency.

mira_ml: Another lever: quantization and int8 paths look stable on our latest evals for 75% of inference requests. If we enable quantized path aggressively for embeddings and rerank, effective throughput per GPU goes up ~1.6x, which reduces required GPU-hours significantly. But need rollback guard rails.

tyler_sourcing: Given lead times, timeline for reservation decision: commit window in 3 weeks to hit H200 orders arriving before the surge. We can do a staggered purchase: 30% ship in week 8, 40% week 12, rest as burst contracts. Need PO + acceptance of risk.

jordan_finance: I'll model costs under three scenarios: Conservative (reserve 70% H200), Balanced (50% reserve + 30% burst + 20% L40S), Aggressive cost-saver (30% H200 reserved, 50% L40S + burst). Expect model by EOD tomorrow.

anna_infra: Action items: 
• @tyler_sourcing prepare a staggered procurement term sheet + estimated vendor lead windows (due in 48h).
• @mira_ml produce hourly demand curve (CSV) for the 10-day window so we can size reservations precisely (due 24h).
• @sam_ops plan autoscale playbook changes and rollback knobs for quantization path (runbook draft 72h).
• @jordan_finance deliver cost-scenario spreadsheet (EOD tomorrow).

deploy-bot: CI: /deploy oncall-playbook ran at 1837654400 — playbook draft pipeline passed basic lint checks.

sam_ops: One more risk: network maintenance in eu-west-1 scheduled by cloud provider one week before surge (we have a maintenance advisory). We should plan capacity slack in other regions.

mira_ml: Good call — I'll add a region-fallback mapping to the demand curve.

anna_infra: Thanks all. If procurement constraints tighten we pivot to more L40S + aggressive quantization. I'll check vendor penalties for later cancellations. :eyes:

mira_ml: Will post the CSV and a short summary in the thread when ready.

sam_ops: 👍

tyler_sourcing: On it — will ping vendors and get provisional quotes.

jordan_finance: Confirmed, doing numbers now.

anna_infra: Closing loop: let's reconvene in this thread once the 48h items land.

mira_ml: Thanks, everyone.
